title: Assistant

composer.useLibraryOn: Searches your offline library when needed and cites the sources
composer.useLibraryOff: Answers come from the model only

empty.title: How can I help?
empty.body: Everything runs on your device. Nothing leaves your phone.
empty.bodyLibrary: Chat with me or ask me anything. When it helps, I'll search your offline library and tell you where each fact comes from.
empty.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Double-check what matters and, for health questions, consult a professional.
empty.disclaimerNoHealth: AI can make mistakes. Double-check what matters.
empty.bodyNoModel: Without an AI model I answer vital emergencies with the guide's cards. For everything else, download a model.

modelBanner.body: Until then, only vital emergencies get an answer. It works offline once downloaded.

searchLibraryHint: Answer again searching your offline library

errors.notInstalled: The selected model is no longer installed. Choose another one.
errors.systemUnavailable: The built-in model isn't available right now.
errors.tooLong: This is too long for the model. Shorten the question or start a new chat.
errors.declined: The built-in model declined to answer this. Try rephrasing it or use a downloaded model.
errors.language: The built-in model doesn't support this language yet.
errors.notReady: The built-in model isn't ready yet. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.busy: The model is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.empty: The model didn't write an answer. Try again or rephrase the question.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.emptyBody: Your chats are saved on this device so you can pick them up later.
conversations.deleteConfirm: “{{title}}” will be deleted from this device.

models.title: Models
models.downloadableBody: Runs entirely on your device with llama.cpp. Bigger models answer better but need more memory and storage.
models.deleteConfirm: {{title}} ({{size}}) will be deleted. You can download it again later.
models.privacy: Models never send your questions anywhere. Downloads come from Hugging Face.

blurb.tiny: Fastest and smallest. Good for simple questions and summaries.
blurb.balanced: The best balance of speed and quality for most phones.
blurb.smart: Smarter, more careful answers. Needs a recent phone.
blurb.multilingual: Google's model with excellent Spanish and 140+ languages.

systemStatus.available: Ready. Fast, private and with no download.
systemStatus.notEnabled: Turn on Apple Intelligence in Settings to use it.
systemStatus.deviceNotEligible: This device can't run the built-in model.
systemStatus.modelNotReady: The system is still preparing the model. Try again later.
systemStatus.unsupported: There's no built-in model on this device.

dictation.hint: Speak and your voice becomes text, offline and without leaving your phone
dictation.deniedBody: Allow microphone access in Settings to dictate your questions. Your voice is processed on your phone and never stored.
dictation.packTitle: This language isn't ready for dictation
dictation.packBody: To dictate offline, your phone needs its voice pack for this language. Download it once now, while you're online.
dictation.packStartedBody: Your phone downloads it in the background. Once it's done you can dictate offline.
dictation.packFailed: The language couldn't be downloaded. Try again with a connection.

map.noPhones: None of them has a phone number in OpenStreetMap.
map.straightOrder: No routing pack for this area: sorted by straight-line distance.
map.onDutyNote: OpenStreetMap doesn't know which pharmacies are on duty today: call first, or check the notice at the nearest one.
map.hoursNote: Opening hours come from OpenStreetMap and may be out of date.
map.pointsTiles: Points taken from the map itself (OpenStreetMap).
map.straightOnly: Straight line: no routing pack covers this trip.
map.fromElsewhere: Navigation always starts from where you are.
map.forCallTitle: For the emergency call: where you are
map.forCallIntro: Read it in this order: the town or neighbourhood, the nearby landmark and, if they ask, the coordinates.
map.amlNote: When you call emergency services from a mobile, the phone usually sends your position to the emergency centre by itself. This is for when they ask, or someone else calls.
map.smsNote: An SMS usually gets through with weak coverage and no data.
map.noContact: I can't find “{{name}}” in your plan's contacts: pick the recipient when sending.
map.chooseTitle: There are several places called “{{query}}”. Which one?

missing.noLocation: I don't know where you are: allow location access to answer this.
missing.noPlace: I can't find “{{query}}” in the installed maps.
missing.noIndex: To find places I need a downloaded map of the area.
missing.noPoints: I don't have emergency points for this area yet. They download with the map when there's a connection.
missing.noResults: I can't find any {{kinds}} near {{query}} in the installed maps.
missing.preparing: I'm still preparing the maps you just downloaded (search and points). Ask me again in a moment.
